pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark regions are defined by irregular polygonal geometries with sharp edge gradients and high angularity. Patch size is maximal on the upper flank and progressively reduces in spatial area toward the ventral and caudal regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space forms a continuous topological graph with frequent junction nodes. Pixel thickness of the corridors varies, with narrower pathways separating smaller patches on the lower flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane exhibits a continuous 1D geometric silhouette with low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations against the background pixels along the upper neck and shoulder.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A localized area of textural disruption and de-pigmentation is visible on the dorsal ridge at the transition between the neck and shoulder.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A deep vertical furrow or skin fold is visible on the mid-flank; a small hyper-pigmented textural anomaly is present on the distal dorsal ridge near the rump.
other_distinctive_markers: The anterior portion of the specimen is partially occluded by foreground vegetation consisting of woody stems and leaves.
